tools.name: daystruct_status
tools.description: Read the public Daystruct manifest and current capabilities.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search normalized entities by databank, type, provider, or capability.

tools.name: get_entity_evidence
tools.description: Read canonical facts, aliases, history, and provenance for an entity.

tools.name: get_context_contract
tools.description: Read a databank's identity, temporal, dimension, and context-packet contract.

tools.name: answer_software_questions
tools.description: Resolve up to four package/API questions and an optional runtime compatibility check.

tools.name: check_security_exposure
tools.description: Given a package and the version you are running, return the known vulnerabilities that affect it, worst first, each with the version that fixes it. Advisories whose affected range could not be parsed are returned under undetermined; treat undetermined as unanswered, never as safe.

tools.name: lookup_vulnerability
tools.description: Given a vulnerability identifier such as a CVE, return what is held about it: the affected package and version range, the version that fixes it, severity, and whether it is recorded as known-exploited. Use this when you have an identifier rather than a package you are running. Fields come back as cl

tools.name: check_release_support
tools.description: Given a product and version, return whether that release line is supported, in security-fix-only maintenance, or past end of life, with the dates behind the answer and the cycles you could upgrade into. A line with no published end-of-life returns undetermined rather than supported.

tools.name: select_model
tools.description: Given a need -- minimum context window, required capabilities, a price ceiling -- return the models that satisfy it, cheapest input price first, with the corroboration behind each record so you can judge how well-sourced it is. Prices are per million tokens. A model with no published price is return

tools.name: read_recent_evidence_changes
tools.description: Read the bounded canonical change feed.

tools.name: discover_daystruct_capabilities
tools.description: Find available Daystruct capabilities, or inspect a capability ID/handle and its result contract before requesting help. Provider availability is not proof a task will succeed.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "lookup_vulnerability" is 925 chars, far longer than this server's median (85). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
